title.zh: 本地 Ollama 编程 Agent：不信 3B 模型，把守卫写成代码
title.en: Ollama Coding Agent, Distrust the 3B Model, Encode the Guard

summary.zh: qwen2.5-coder:3b 写完文件就宣布「退出码 0」，其实什么都没跑。Local Ollama Harness 把每一种失败模式写成守卫里的一条确定性规则：模型只提议，裁决权在 harness。
summary.en: A 3B model wrote the file, announced exit code 0, and had run nothing. Local Ollama Harness turns each failure mode into one guard rule: the model proposes, the harness disposes.

title.zh: 为什么我不做 Agent 框架，而做一层 Runtime
title.en: Why a Runtime, Not Another Agent Framework

summary.zh: 每个 agent 框架最终都会撞上同一堵墙。Intent OS 的回答是不做第八十个框架：意图编译成带验收标准的计划，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链。
summary.en: Every agent harness hits the same wall. Intent OS is not the 80th framework: intent compiles into a plan with acceptance criteria, side effects are gated, receipts are hash-chained.

title.zh: 把 Milkdown 塞进 WebView：混血编辑器的取舍与代价
title.en: Milkdown in a WebView: What a Hybrid Editor Costs

summary.zh: Flutter 做壳，WebView 里跑 Milkdown，中间一条 JS 桥——不是偷懒，是取舍。单一桥协议、SAF URI 持久化、手写 OOXML、主题单向流，四个决定各有一笔账。
summary.en: A Flutter shell, Milkdown in a WebView, one JS bridge between them: a deliberate trade, not a shortcut. One bridge protocol, persisted SAF URIs, hand-rolled OOXML, one-way theming.

title.zh: 给不可信的模型造笼子：Claude Code Hook 与 LLM 安全
title.en: A Cage for One Untrusted Model: A Claude Code Hook for LLM Security

summary.zh: 代码管必然，人管例外，模型管灰区——三层防线只锁 Claude Code 里那个 MiniMax：换任何别的模型，这套笼子零开销。
summary.en: Code handles the certain, humans handle the exceptions, a model handles the gray zone: three layers lock down MiniMax inside Claude Code, and no other model.
